units: SI except program areas marked sq ft

section_iteration.revision: Increased both chord depth and diagonal section to reduce long-term deflection in the 1 GN/m slip scenario and create more gross area for tension-node detailing.

structural_scope.method: Small-displacement planar axial finite elements. Pin at west bearing; vertical roller at east. Each joint free in rotation. Sections are solid fabricated timber.

material.species_grade_basis: Balanced Douglas-fir 24F-V8, dry-service reference. Fabricated custom block-glulam members. Require supplier evaluation for actual dimensions and layup.
material.orthotropy: Grain follows every bar. The 2D axial model uses E-long only. Species-level E_R/E_L and E_T/E_L are on the order of 0.05–0.07, not longitudinal E. Joint bearing, rolling shear and CLT plate behavior require orientation- and product-specific properties.

structural_scope.load_scope: Two complete occupied deck footprints for all schemes, including voids and the removed west tip deck. Roof tributary included. Floor-reaction collectors and decking must frame to nodes. Nominal gravity scenario for concept comparison; local snow drift, wind uplift, and actual assembly/gallery/concentrated loads still require project-specific determination.
structural_scope.stability_screen: Dry-reference axial screen using NDS column-stability equation c=0.9, other factors taken as unity, K=1 and full member length between pinned ends independently in each axis. Whole-section widths require factory block gluing; field bolting separate leaves does not establish composite weak-axis inertia. Every panel point requires positive transverse restraint with roof/deck diaphragms, cross-frames and bracing back to the cores, including cut-floor tips. Lower nodes cannot rely on a missing CLT deck.

service_criteria.joint_screen: 2 GN/m per assembled member-end is a comparison assumption. 0.5–4 GN/m are sensitivities, not connector test results. Forces use two axial springs per bar; full envelopes include all occupancy patterns. The paired trusses, bearing and core may deform beyond this idealization.
service_criteria.creep_screen: 1.5 times permanent plus immediate transient compares dry-service response. 2.0 is adverse sensitivity; no additional persistent exhibition loading included. Long-term connector slip must be tested separately.

structural_scope.support_detail: Seat the bearing post directly on a concealed shoe spreading load into the core. The post end transmits compression parallel to grain. Additional chord and floor forces must enter the same bearing node. Avoid imposing the entire reaction across the side grain of a continuous lower chord. Detail end-grain drainage, movement, replaceable bearings and temporary hold-down for erection.
structural_scope.fabrication: Custom factory block-glulam with parallel grain and certified structural glue lines. Transport 2–3-panel chord lengths (7.2–10.8 m), individual posts and diagonals; field-assemble at centrelines on engineered falsework. Provide concealed symmetric multi-plate/dowel groups, direct compression seats and accessible protected node pockets; stagger chord splice locations where practicable and explicitly design each reversing splice. Replace a member only after unloading and engineered temporary shoring. Pin one core bearing and slide the opposite shoe longitudinally. Prove joist collectors, distributed force transfer, plate slot net area, tension perpendicular to grain, group tear-out, dowel yielding, splits, fire cover and core anchors independently.
structural_scope.scope_limit: Concept calculations are not construction documents. No 3D lateral analysis, weathering or fire residual section, foundation design, core/connection deformation validation, diaphragm or secondary-beam vibration assessment, fabrication release, or site erection-stage approval.

roof_frame_alternatives.basis: Independent vendor roof frames before column sharing.

annual_energy.method: PVWatts v8 hourly AC, fixed roof, 14% assumed other losses. Beam weighted by DNI times incidence / POA, residual irradiance treated as isotropic diffuse; area-linear shade response. Visible city meshes, including trees and glazing, are opaque all year. No electrical string mismatch or explicit seasonal snow-cover model; conceptual estimate.

checks.geometry: Reopened the serialized GLB. Checked finite coordinates, face areas, outward winding, positive volume and two opposite directed edges per shell edge; all parts within the registered parcel. Shell intersections at structural connections are intentional.

walks.stairs: Passed 12 floor-to-floor routes in the two stair cores, ascending and descending.
walks.street: 11 bidirectional street routes and the continuous switchback to the forum passed across 13924 grade and clearance samples.
walks.interior: 24 mapped interior corridor routes support 1.2192 m with doors shut and fully open. The open hall threshold and ten washroom fixture approaches are clear.
walks.doors_and_worktables: 52/52 portals connect to the street; 32 worktables and four freight landings checked; 0 clearance or route issues.

checks.forum_roof: The forum slopes 8.5 degrees. Plumb-ended rafters frame into pitched girder tops, the columns meet the girder soffits, and the metal heads terminate the facade glazing below the deck.

classroom_approach_structure.scope: Elastic gravity comparison using the assumed studio loads. No connection resistance, creep, vibration, fire or lateral design is certified.

checks.arcade_bearings: 14 founded common masts, 10 canopy frames, 21 roof rafters, 17 ramp cantilevers, 2 low-level concrete outrigger caps, 5 bridge cantilevers, two turn joists and 18 bridge joists. Roof, flights, turning deck, threshold, bridge and vestibule have continuous bearings.

upper_promenade_gravity.model_basis: Horizontal projected area of the three upper flights, both corner landings and upper studio threshold/link, measured from the loaded GLB.
upper_promenade_gravity.assumptions: One fully occupied walk at the same 2.70 kPa dead and 4.80 kPa live study pressures as the main decks. North and south flights load their adjoining truss. The west return and both corner landings are taken wholly by its transverse frames for this comparison. Their supports divide load by transverse position. Sign convention is positive downward on the supporting member.
upper_promenade_gravity.limits: Gravity reaction comparison only. Local connection strength and stiffness, eccentric torque, railing loads, snow, wind, vibration and foundation design require separate engineering.

ground_support_revision.scope: Market arcade, two switchback flights, turning and bridge landings, forum bridge, vendor roofs and basement.
ground_support_revision.scope_of_checks: Column counts refer to distinct load-bearing locations within each stated area. Geometry, walking clearances and preliminary gravity actions are reported separately. Lateral capacity, vibration, anchorage, fire design and soil bearing require engineering verification.

arcade_concept_gravity_assumptions.note: Service cases for span reactions and transverse overturning about the arcade mast. Values are input assumptions, not local design actions or resistance capacities.
